Practice makes clean landings

AIR CONTROL

Slow motion · unlimited retries · no coin rewards
Controller controls

Left stick steers. RT accelerates, LT brakes. Hold and release A to jump. Right stick spins and flips. Small stick movements make fine adjustments; full tilt gives full rotation speed. RB grabs, LB tucks. X/B barrel roll. Press left stick to stabilize. Start pauses, Back returns to checkpoint, Y opens photo mode. In the cabin, A opens the trail map; press A again to ride.

Expert requires tighter alignment, slower rotation, and less sideways drift before touchdown. Race records and ghosts are saved separately.

Rails — use A/D to balance. Keep the marker centered for a bonus, or jump off before losing balance. On a snowboard, hold F (or Grab / RB) to turn into a boardslide for extra points and a harder balance challenge.

Space — hold and release in the green zone.

Q / E — spin left / right.
Z / X — frontflip / backflip.
B / V — barrel roll left / right.
F — Indy grab.
H / J — nose / tail grab.
N / M — cork left / right.
K / L — frontflip + spin left / right.
G — tuck for faster doubles and triples.
Shift — slow your rotation.

Hold N or M to combine a backflip with two spins for a cork 720. K or L combines a frontflip with two spins in the opposite flipping direction. On touch screens, cycle Moves to Combos. Hold G with a flip key for double or triple rotations when you have enough airtime. Complete full flips and rolls, then release the trick keys. Land with your board pointing along the slope. On a snowboard, a landed 180 or 540 puts you in switch stance; land another half-turn to return. Steering stays the same.

Try Trick practice from the trail map. Time slows to 40% in the air, and R returns you to the training kicker. Progress rewards come from the other events.

Green alignment means your angles and rotation speed are ready. Clean landings earn a 25% bonus. An unfinished rotation causes a wipeout.

Cyan diamond markers show checkpoints every 200 m. They turn lime when your progress is saved. Press R to return to your last checkpoint, or T for a new run.
